title: LakituAudit
description: One pane action in the Lakitu audit log (decision 0100; 0075 point 6). Records a SHA-256 hash of the login id, never a login name, token, secret, address or account name. stopped_at is allowed on pane_closed only.

login_hash.description: SHA-256 of the login id, as 64 lowercase hex characters. Never the login name.

pane_id.description: ULID of the pane, with the pn_ prefix.

mode.description: The pane mode at the time of the event.

at.description: When the event happened, RFC 3339 in UTC.

stopped_at.description: When the pane stopped. Present on pane_closed only.
